name: a roll call of names lights up under candlelit arches
looks: A row of silhouetted figures stands beneath a line of candlelit arches. Their names build in underneath them left to right, one at a time, each new name landing bright while the earlier ones settle to a dimmer, secondary brightness.
build: Each name fades/rises in on a short stagger left to right, landing at full brightness then easing down to a secondary opacity as the next one lands, same mechanic as list-stack-reveal; the candle flames flicker gently on a seeded loop throughout.
sound: A soft tick per name landing, a quiet ambient hum of a shared room underneath.
prompt: Stand a row of silhouetted figures beneath candlelit arches and build their names in underneath them left to right, one at a time, each new name landing bright while the earlier ones dim to secondary, so a panel or committee introduces itself as a single held breath rather than a list.
